summary: Rework: fixed all 4 issues flagged by QA.

6) Extended FakeMovieRepository with SetCurrentFilePaths() to support the new MoviesListViewModel dialog invocation test.
All 435 App-layer tests and 309 unit tests pass (744 total, 0 failures).

comments.note: CanGenerateThumbnails() defensive guard gap: the CanExecute method checks SelectedMovies.Count > 0 && _generatorDialogService is not null, but GenerateThumbnailsAsync also uses _movieRepository!, _generationService!, and _thumbnailRepo! with null-forgiving operators. If anyone constructs MoviesListViewModel with generatorDialogService but without the other three services and then adds SelectedMovies, CanExecute returns true and the command NREs at _movieRepository!.GetCurrentFilePathsAsync. In production DI all four are provided together, so this is a test-misuse edge case only. Recommend adding _movieRepository is not null to CanGenerateThumbnails() for full defensive coverage.

LoadMediaInfoAsync bare catch blocks (carry-forward from Developer): two nested catch{} blocks silently swallow all exceptions during JSON stream/format parsing. Intentional design but reduces diagnostic visibility. A future pass could add ILogger warning calls or structured logging in the catch blocks without altering the happy-path behavior.
